title: feat: solid voxelization of normalized meshes (issue 0010)
abstract:
## Summary

Implements [issue 0010](docs/issues/0010-solid-voxelization.md) (child of the M1 tracking issue 0001): convert a normalized `MeshData` (watertight assumed) into the solid voxel target that `growAssembly` consumes. Method was fixed in advance by the [issue 0008 spike](docs/issues/0008-spike-voxelization-method.md); no design decisions were open.

```
MeshData (mm / Z-up / grounded) → 6-direction majority vote (±X/±Y/±Z odd-even ray parity)
→ { voxels: Map<"i,j,k", colorId>, seed }  // voxel centers at (i,j,k)·voxelMm — grow.ts convention
```

## Changes

- `src/domain/voxelize.ts` — `voxelizeSolid(mesh, voxelMm, colorId)`. Hand-rolled Möller–Trumbore ray-triangle intersection accelerated by per-axis uniform triangle grids (3 shared grids vs the spike's 6 — cheaper index construction). Majority threshold `votes >= 3` (ties inside) — **verified identical to the spike's measured baseline** (`Math.ceil(6/2)`). Zero three.js dependency; `colorId` is a parameter so the domain layer stays palette-free (this deviates from the issue's originally drafted signature; the issue doc is updated accordingly).
- `src/domain/voxelize.test.ts` — 6 tests with analytic ground truth.
- Issue doc updated: contract signature + per-criterion evidence, marked done.

## Acceptance criteria (measured)

- [x] Error rate ≤ 2% vs analytic solution — sphere **1.44%** (r=20mm, 1280 faces), box **0.0047%**
- [x] Interior is filled (solid, not shell) — central 3×3×3 block fully filled (sphere placed off-origin to avoid the axis-aligned ray degeneracy known from the spike)
- [x] Seed = filled voxel on lowest-k layer nearest the (i,j) bbox center (same policy as `generator.cellsToVoxels`)
- [x] 40³-equivalent timing logged — **~75ms** (20480-face icosphere, 32764 voxels; spike measured 85–103ms)

## Review notes (orchestrated delegation)

Implemented by a sonnet implementer subagent; reviewed with all four checks re-run independently (lint / format:check / **109 tests** / build — green). The majority-vote threshold claim ("follows the spike baseline") was cross-checked against the spike source before approval. Zero review round-trips needed.
